inputs.note: Needs the OCR locate path. Tolerance rule, D37 (the locate work measured it): the factory's boxes are computed from font metrics while drawing and Tesseract's are ink-tight, so raw IoU is the wrong comparison on a scan — measured IoU median ~0.64 against horizontal IoU ~0.95. On a scanned page, map the candidate box back through transform.pages[i].pdf_points_to_image_px and assert the box CENTRE falls inside the ground-truth box (or, equivalently, horizontal IoU >= 0.9). Raw IoU >= 0.5 is kept for clean pages only, where both boxes come from the same font metrics.

expected: A value that exists only in a raster page is located via the OCR path and comes back with a box in the clean layout's coordinate space, agreeing with ground truth under the scanned-page tolerance rule (centre-inside after the recorded transform, or horizontal IoU >= 0.9) rather than under raw IoU.
guards_against: Two failures at once: an OCR-path locate regression that silently degrades every scanned document to unsupported, and a raw-IoU tolerance that would report that regression on correct output — an assertion that fails on ink-tight boxes gets loosened until it stops testing anything.
